text:
Hello dear community 🌹
I would really appreciate your advice and guidance 🙏🏻

About 9 years ago, my Israeli partner and I (I’m French) started the process for a Partner Visa in Israel. We separated in 2022, just before I was due to receive my permanent A/5 visa. At that point, I already had a temporary Teudat Zehut.

Since then, I’ve been travelling and have only returned to Israel occasionally as a visitor. After all these years apart, we have recently gotten back together and would now like to resume the Partner Visa process.

Does anyone know whether we would have to start the entire process again from scratch, or whether there is any way to resume the previous application and make the process shorter?

The thought of going through the whole process again is quite discouraging, as it can take such a long time.

If anyone has been through something similar, or has experience with this process, I would be incredibly grateful for any advice or guidance 🙏🏻

Thank you so much! 🙏🏻🤍✨
